findings.message: Raw <h1> where tenet-ui provides <Heading>. import { Heading } from 'tenet-ui'. Guideline: Components.
Raw colour #c2410c — no tenet-ui token has this value; pick a --fgColor-* token (e.g. var(--fgColor-default)). Guideline: Foundations > Color.
`block` on <Button> is deprecated since tenet-ui 0.4.0; use `fullWidth`. Use `fullWidth` instead (renamed in 0.4.0). `block` keeps working until 0.5.0. Guideline: Changelog > Deprecations.
